description.en:
X2 is AgiBot's humanoid family for interactive services, demonstrations and movement development. It combines whole-body motion with visual, spoken and touch-based interaction, allowing gestures and expressions to accompany conversations or performances. The manufacturer describes different body configurations with approximately 25 to 30 degrees of freedom.

The range includes entry and flagship editions with different sensing, navigation and hand options. Advanced autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance are associated with specified higher configurations, while optional dexterous hands and teleoperation accessories support additional development work. X2 therefore represents a configurable platform whose delivered capabilities depend on the chosen edition.
